csv_project_name: Design for Meadow Sensory Trail Title I & II
csv_scope_of_work: The Bureau of Land Management (BLM) is seeking one qualified firm to provide A/E services for Title I, II A/E Services for Meadowood Sensory Trail Title I and II. Provide Title I and Title II A/E services for the design of a new Sensory Nature Trail within the Meadowood Special Recreation Management Area in Lorton, Virginia, along with topographic survey services for the Mustang Trailhead Parking Area and the Enchanted Pond Outflow Area. For the Sensory Nature Trail, the selected A/E firm will develop the full design for an approximately one-mile, ABA-accessible loop trail featuring multiple sensory-focused activity stations, natural amenities, a trailhead entrance structure, parking area, access road, and two stream crossings requiring engineered solutions. The design will draw inspiration from comparable sensory trails (such as the Autism Nature Trail) and must incorporate input from a qualified sensory-integration specialist. Deliverables will advance through the 35%, 65%, 95%, and 100% design stages, including drawings, specifications, and Class C, B, and A cost estimates.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geology, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Cost Estimating, Site Evaluation/Selection, Planning/Master Planning, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater

project_scope: Design of a new approximately one-mile ABA-accessible loop sensory nature trail within Meadowood Special Recreation Management Area. The project includes multiple sensory-focused activity stations, natural amenities, a trailhead entrance structure, parking area, access road, and two stream crossings requiring engineered solutions. It also includes topographic survey services for the Mustang Trailhead Parking Area and the Enchanted Pond Outflow Area. Deliverables progress through 35%, 65%, 95%, and 100% design stages with drawings, specifications, and Class C, B, and A cost estimates.
services: Title I and Title II A/E services including landscape architecture, civil engineering, geology, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, site evaluation/selection, planning/master planning, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, and stormwater design.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a park and trail design project, which is generally outside sbp's core focus.
- Includes two stream crossings requiring engineered solutions, offering a limited structural component.
- Structural engineering is requested, but the main scope is landscape architecture and site development.
- Small overall construction budget indicates limited structural complexity and fee potential.
- Not a bridge-focused procurement with clear span data or a major special structure.

fee_explanation: No explicit fee information provided in the tender documents. Scope includes Title I and Title II A/E services through 100% design, but no design fee or percentage is stated.
references_qualifications: One qualified A/E firm is sought. The scope requires multidisciplinary qualifications in landscape architecture, civil engineering, geology, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, site evaluation/selection, planning/master planning, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, and stormwater.
